stories.h: Photon fluctuations offer new way to probe electron dynamics in crystals
stories.t: Intense laser light can make a crystal emit new colors at frequencies many times higher than that of the original beam. This process, known as high-harmonic generation, provides a powerful way to investigate the rapid motion of electrons in solids.

stories.h: A mysterious twist in the universe’s oldest light could reveal new physics
stories.t: Scientists have spotted hints of a mysterious rotation in the universe’s oldest light that could reveal new physics and shed light on dark matter and dark energy.
